title: Paul's Joy over the Church's Repentance

questions.question: Since we have these promises, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from every defilement of body and spirit, bringing ____ to completion in the fear of God.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:1 (ESV): "Since we have these promises, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from every defilement of body and spirit, bringing holiness to completion in the fear of God."

questions.question: Paul asks them to make room in their hearts for him, stating: "We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have taken ____ of no one."
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:2 (ESV): "Make room in your hearts for us. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have taken advantage of no one."

questions.question: For even when we came into Macedonia, our bodies had no rest, but we were afflicted at every turn—fighting without and ____ within.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:5 (ESV): "For even when we came into Macedonia, our bodies had no rest, but we were afflicted at every turn—fighting without and fear within."

questions.question: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the coming of ____,
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:6 (ESV): "But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the coming of Titus,"

questions.question: Titus comforted Paul not only by his coming but also by the comfort with which he was comforted by the Corinthians, as he told Paul of their longing, their mourning, and their ____ for Paul.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:7 (ESV): "and not only by his coming but also by the comfort with which he was comforted by you, as he told us of your longing, your mourning, your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more."

questions.question: Paul says that even if he made them grieve with his letter, he does not ____ it—though he did at first.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:8 (ESV): "For even if I made you grieve with my letter, I do not regret it—though I did regret it, for I see that that letter grieved you, though only for a while."

questions.question: Now Paul rejoices, not because they were grieved, but because their grief led to ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:9 (ESV): "As it is, I rejoice, not because you were grieved, but because you were grieved into repenting. For you felt a godly grief, so that you suffered no loss through us."

questions.question: For godly grief produces a repentance that leads to ____ without regret, whereas worldly grief produces death.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:10 (ESV): "For godly grief produces a repentance that leads to salvation without regret, whereas worldly grief produces death."

questions.question: Whereas godly grief produces a repentance that leads to salvation, what does worldly grief produce?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:10 (ESV): "For godly grief produces a repentance that leads to salvation without regret, whereas worldly grief produces death."

questions.question: Paul lists the results of their godly grief. Which of these is NOT one of the things it produced in them?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:11 (ESV): "For see what earnestness this godly grief has produced in you, but also what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what fear, what longing, what zeal, what punishment!" Generosity is discussed in chapters 8-9, not here.

questions.question: So although I wrote to you, it was not for the sake of the one who did the wrong, nor for the sake of the one who suffered the wrong, but in order that your ____ for us might be revealed to you in the sight of God.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:12 (ESV): "So although I wrote to you, it was not for the sake of the one who did the wrong, nor for the sake of the one who suffered the wrong, but in order that your earnestness for us might be revealed to you in the sight of God."

questions.question: And besides our own comfort, we rejoiced still more at the joy of Titus, because his ____ has been set at rest by you all.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:13 (ESV): "Therefore we are comforted. And besides our own comfort, we rejoiced still more at the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been set at rest by you all."

questions.question: For whatever boasts Paul had made to Titus about the Corinthians, he was not put to ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:14 (ESV): "For whatever boasts I made to him about you, I was not put to shame."

questions.question: Titus's affection for them is even greater as he remembers what from them all?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:15 (ESV): "And his affection for you is even greater, as he remembers the obedience of you all, how you received him with fear and trembling."

questions.question: How does Paul conclude chapter 7 regarding his confidence in the Corinthians?
options: "I rejoice, because I have complete confidence in you."
"I trust you will continue in the grace of God."
"I pray that you will not stumble again."
questions.correctAnswer: "I rejoice, because I have complete confidence in you."
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 7:16 (ESV): "I rejoice, because I have complete confidence in you."

key_verse_text: For godly grief produces a repentance that leads to salvation without regret, whereas worldly grief produces death.
